When it comes to the common rights and needs of men and women, there is no distinction between the rich and the poor, the powerful and the powerless. Every individual deserves access to the basic necessities of life—food, shelter, and security—and the opportunity to pursue their dreams. This principle has guided our nation’s greatest achievements, from the abolition of slavery to the expansion of civil rights. It is a reminder that our shared humanity binds us together, and together, we must continue to champion justice, equality, and dignity for all.

This is not just about innovation for its own sake, but about harnessing the power of discovery to address some of humanity’s most pressing challenges. By investing in these efforts, we can ensure a brighter future for generations to come. It is our responsibility to support this work, to encourage collaboration among researchers, and to provide the resources necessary for success. Together, we can turn this promise into reality.

The federal government will not micromanage how schools are run. We believe strongly -- we believe in the power of local communities to make decisions that best serve their students. By empowering them with the resources and flexibility they need, we can ensure that every child has access to a quality education. Together, we can build a future where every student thrives, and every community flourishes.

So tonight I announce the Advanced Energy Initiative--a 22-percent increase in clean-energy research--at the Department of Energy, to push the boundaries of technology and unlock new possibilities for our nation’s energy future. Every American—from scientists in laboratories to workers on factory floors—has a stake in this critical endeavor. Together, we can harness the innovative spirit that has always defined our nation and build a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow. Let us rise to this challenge with the same determination and unity that have guided us through trials before.

By empowering people to take control of their health care spending, we ensure that no one has to choose between their well-being and their wallet. This reform is a step toward a more equitable system, where every citizen can access the care they need without fear of undue hardship. Together, we can build a healthier, more resilient nation.

During the last two years, we have seen what can be accomplished when we work together, united in purpose and resolve. Our nation has faced challenges that tested our strength and determination, yet we have emerged stronger and more resilient. The spirit of cooperation has driven us to achieve remarkable progress, whether in rebuilding communities, strengthening our defenses, or fostering innovation. Moving forward, let us continue to harness this collective power, ensuring that our shared efforts pave the way for a brighter, more secure future for all.

Members, you and I will work together in the months ahead on other issues: productive and meaningful reforms to strengthen our economy, ensuring that every American has access to the opportunities they deserve. We must also address the pressing challenges of healthcare affordability and education quality, forging solutions that empower families and communities. By uniting our efforts, we can uphold the values of fairness and progress that define our nation. Together, we will build a future of promise and resilience for generations to come.

For many Americans, these four months have brought sorrow and pain that will never completely fade. Yet, in the midst of this grief, we have also witnessed acts of courage and compassion that remind us of the strength of the human spirit. Neighbors have opened their homes to strangers, volunteers have worked tirelessly to rebuild shattered communities, and countless individuals have given generously to support those in need. These moments of unity and resilience are a testament to the enduring power of hope and the unyielding resolve of the American people. Together, we will continue to heal, to rebuild, and to move forward, guided by the belief that even in the darkest times, light can and will prevail.

In Africa, the disease clouds the future of entire nations and threatens to hold back the progress of generations yet to come. We must act with urgency and conviction, for the stakes are too high to ignore. By mobilizing global resources and fostering partnerships, we can confront this crisis head-on. Every nation, every organization, and every individual has a role to play. Together, we can bring hope, healing, and a renewed sense of possibility to those who need it most.

When credible intelligence warrants, appropriate law enforcement and local officials are alerted. These warnings are, of course, disseminated with utmost care to ensure public safety while avoiding unnecessary alarm. It is crucial that such intelligence is acted upon swiftly and decisively, yet always grounded in transparency and accountability. The protection of our communities demands vigilance, but it also requires trust—trust that those in authority will act with wisdom and restraint, balancing the need for security with the preservation of our freedoms. Together, we can face these challenges with resolve.

Twelve years ago, Iraq invaded Kuwait without provocation. And the regime's forces were poised to continue their march, threatening the sovereignty and resources of neighboring nations. Had we hesitated, the consequences would have been dire, not only for the region but for the global order. Yet, through decisive action and unwavering unity, the coalition halted this aggression, upholding the principles of peace and security. Today, we must remain vigilant, committed to defending freedom and standing firm against tyranny wherever it arises.

When America serves others in this way, we show the strength and generosity of our great nation, and we strengthen the bonds of unity that define us as a people. By extending a hand to those in need, we not only uphold our values but also inspire others to follow our example. This legacy of service and compassion is woven into the fabric of our history, reminding us that even in the face of adversity, we can rise together. Let us continue to lead with courage and kindness, proving that our light shines brightest when shared with the world.

America pursues medical advances in the name of life, and we will achieve the great promise of modern medicine for all our citizens. Through innovation and determination, we can conquer diseases that have plagued humanity for generations. By investing in research and ensuring access to cutting-edge treatments, we affirm our commitment to the dignity and well-being of every individual. Together, we can build a future where no one is left behind in the fight for health and hope.

We must remain vigilant and resolute, working with our allies to dismantle these networks and prevent their ambitions from taking root. The stakes are too high to falter, and the cost of inaction is far greater than the challenges we face today. Together, we can ensure that Iraq remains a beacon of hope, not a haven for terror.

The roots of our democracy can be traced to England, and to its Parliament -- a body that has stood as a beacon of governance and law for centuries. From the Magna Carta to the Glorious Revolution, the principles of liberty, representation, and justice have been forged in the crucible of history. These ideals crossed the Atlantic, taking root in the fertile soil of a new nation, where they blossomed into the Constitution and the Bill of Rights. Today, we honor that legacy by upholding the rule of law, ensuring that every voice is heard, and safeguarding the freedoms that define us as a people. Let us never forget that the strength of our democracy lies in its enduring commitment to these timeless values.

Tonight I also ask you to reform our immigration laws so they reflect our values and strengthen our economy. We must ensure that our borders are secure while offering a fair and compassionate path to citizenship for those who have followed our laws, paid their taxes, and contributed to the fabric of our nation. It is time to embrace the diversity that has always defined us, welcoming the talents and dreams of immigrants who seek a better life. Let us remember that America’s greatness has been built by generations of newcomers who brought their energy, innovation, and hope to our shores. Together, we can craft a system that honors both our security and our heritage as a nation of immigrants.

We must not allow doubt to cloud our vision or weaken our determination. The challenges we face are formidable, but so too is our capacity to overcome them. Together, with unwavering faith in our shared purpose, we will continue to forge a future defined by hope, strength, and unity.

Taken together, these steps represent decisive action to ease the credit crunch that is now weakening our economy and threatening the livelihoods of millions of Americans. This effort demands the cooperation of Congress, the private sector, and every citizen. Let us move forward with urgency and resolve, knowing that our collective actions will pave the way for renewal and prosperity.

In the case of Iraq, the Security Council did act, in the early 1990s. Under the leadership of the United States and a broad coalition, the Security Council enforced resolutions to halt Saddam Hussein's aggression and to ensure the liberation of Kuwait. These actions reaffirmed the authority of international law and the importance of collective security. Today, we face new challenges, but the lessons of the past remain clear: unity, resolve, and decisive action are essential to confronting threats and upholding the principles of peace and justice for all nations.

My opponent recently announced that he is the conservative -- the candidate of "conservative values," but let us examine what those values truly mean. Are they values that protect the vulnerable, uphold justice, and ensure the dignity of every American? Or do they merely serve the interests of the privileged few? Conservatism is not about preserving the status quo; it’s about safeguarding the principles that make our nation strong—freedom, responsibility, and opportunity for all. Let us remember that true leadership isn’t defined by labels but by actions that lift up every citizen, ensuring no one is left behind.

This changed world can be a time of great opportunity for all Americans to earn a better future and to contribute meaningfully to the prosperity of our nation. By embracing innovation and fostering collaboration, we can address the challenges of this era with resilience and determination. Every individual, from seasoned professionals to eager students, has the potential to play a pivotal role in shaping our collective destiny. As we move forward, let us seize this moment to strengthen our communities, empower our workforce, and build a legacy of progress for generations to come.

While the most visible military action is in Afghanistan, America is acting elsewhere. We now have amplified our efforts to dismantle terrorist networks across the globe, from the deserts of North Africa to the jungles of Southeast Asia. Our intelligence and special operations teams are working tirelessly, often unseen, to thwart threats before they materialize. This global vigilance is not just about defending our shores; it’s about safeguarding the freedom and security of all nations. In this endeavor, we stand united with allies who share our resolve, and together, we will ensure that the scourge of terrorism finds no refuge. Every nation, every community, has a part to play in this mission, and America will lead by example, as we always have.

The United States respects the people of Afghanistan--after all, we are currently its largest source of humanitarian aid. Our commitment to their future remains steadfast, as we work alongside international partners to rebuild infrastructure, strengthen governance, and foster economic growth. The Afghan people have shown remarkable resilience in the face of adversity, and it is our duty to support their aspirations for peace and stability. Together, we can help Afghanistan emerge as a nation of opportunity, where every citizen can thrive and contribute to a brighter tomorrow.

In the wake of this tragedy, we must stand united, determined to defend the principles that make us strong. Our resolve is unshakable, our commitment unwavering. Together, we will confront those who seek to harm us, ensure justice is served, and reaffirm our dedication to liberty and security for all. This is our duty, and we will not falter.

Our nation, working with allies and friends, has also confronted the enemy abroad, with measures both overt and unseen. These efforts have dismantled terror networks, disrupted plots before they could claim innocent lives, and denied sanctuary to those who seek to do us harm. In places far from our shores—mountains, deserts, shadowed cities—brave men and women stand watch, risking all so that we may live without fear. Their victories, though often unheralded, are written in the quiet of unbroken dawns, in the safety of children’s laughter. Yet we must remain vigilant. The adversaries of freedom adapt, and so must we. Every tool of intelligence, diplomacy, and lawful force must be wielded with precision and resolve. For in this struggle, there is no neutral ground; indifference is the ally of oppression. Together, with steadfast allies, we will prevail—not merely by strength of arms, but by the unshakable conviction that liberty is the birthright of every soul.

To make our economy stronger and more productive, we must make health care more affordable, accessible, and reliable for every American family. By expanding innovative solutions like health savings accounts and lowering the cost of prescription drugs, we can ensure that no one is forced to choose between paying for medicine and putting food on the table. Additionally, we must work to reduce the burden of medical debt, which too often stifles economic growth and traps families in cycles of hardship. It is through these reforms that we will create a healthier, more prosperous nation for generations to come.

Their commitment to building a future rooted in liberty and justice inspires us all. Together, we stand with them in this pivotal moment, reaffirming our shared belief in the power of democracy to transform nations and uplift humanity.

With nuclear arms or a full arsenal of chemical and biological weapons, Saddam Hussein could resume his campaign of terror and domination, threatening not only the stability of the Middle East but the security of nations across the globe. His regime’s history of aggression and deceit underscores the urgency of dismantling his capacity for destruction. The world cannot afford to turn a blind eye to such a peril. We must act decisively, with resolve and unity, to prevent the spread of these deadly weapons and ensure that no dictator can hold humanity hostage to his ambitions.

The terrorists do not merely object to American actions in Iraq and elsewhere, they object to the very existence of our values, our freedoms, and our way of life. Their hatred is not confined to any single policy or intervention; it is rooted in a rejection of the principles upon which our nation stands. Liberty, equality, and the pursuit of happiness are not merely ideals to them—they are threats. And so, they seek to destroy not just our troops abroad, but the foundations of the society we have built. In confronting this threat, we must remain steadfast, united, and resolute, for the stakes are nothing less than the survival of the freedoms we hold dear.

In an ownership society, more people will own their health care plans, and have the confidence and security that comes with personal control over their medical decisions. Families will have the freedom to choose the coverage that best fits their needs, without being constrained by rigid mandates or bureaucratic hurdles. By empowering individuals with the tools to make informed choices, we foster a system that prioritizes affordability, accessibility, and quality care for all. This vision strengthens not only our health care system but also the fabric of our communities, as citizens take greater responsibility for their well-being and that of their loved ones. Together, we can build a future where every American has the opportunity to thrive, supported by a health care structure that values choice, innovation, and personal accountability.

While many of our citizens prosper, others doubt the promise, even the justice, of our own society. They see a widening divide, a chasm of opportunity that seems insurmountable. Yet, we must remember that our nation was built on the belief that every individual has the potential to rise, to contribute, and to thrive. It is our collective responsibility to bridge this gap, to ensure that no one is left behind in the pursuit of the American Dream. Through partnerships between government, private sector, and community organizations, we can create pathways to success for all. Let us commit to lifting each other up, to fostering innovation, and to restoring faith in the promise that together, we can achieve lasting prosperity for every citizen.

Our nation will continue to be steadfast and patient and persistent in the pursuit of our shared goals of peace, security, and prosperity. We will stand firm against those who seek to undermine these ideals, whether through violence, coercion, or deceit. Our resolve is unwavering, and our commitment to justice remains unshaken. Together, we will forge a future where freedom flourishes, where hope prevails, and where the dignity of every individual is upheld. This is our promise, and this is our path forward.

In this place, there's a custom for the funerals of jazz musicians. The funeral procession moves through the streets with a slow, soulful rhythm, accompanied by the mournful wail of trumpets and the steady beat of marching drums. Friends, family, and fans join together in a shared lament, their voices rising in solemn harmony. It’s a celebration of life as much as a farewell, a reminder that the music lives on even as the musician departs. And so, the notes linger, echoing through the heart of the city long after the procession fades.

This new temporary worker program will bring more than economic benefits to America. Our homeland will be strengthened by the contributions of those who come to work, pay taxes, and abide by our laws. These individuals will fill vital roles in industries essential to our nation’s growth, from agriculture to technology. By creating a legal and orderly process, we reduce the strain on our borders and ensure that all who come here do so with dignity and respect. This program reflects our values as a nation of immigrants, built by the hard work and determination of people from every corner of the globe. Together, we can forge a future that honors both our heritage and our shared aspirations.

The United States has a long and proud record of leading the world toward advances in science, technology, and innovation. From the moon landing to the development of the internet, American ingenuity has shaped the modern era. Yet, our leadership extends beyond invention; it is rooted in a commitment to shared progress and global collaboration. By fostering partnerships and investing in education, we ensure that the benefits of discovery reach every corner of the world, empowering nations and uplifting humanity.

In January of 2006, seniors can get prescription drug coverage under Medicare. For a monthly premium of about $35, most seniors who do not have that coverage today can expect to see their drug bills cut roughly in half. Under this reform, senior citizens will have the freedom to select a plan that aligns with their health needs, ensuring they receive the medications they require without undue financial strain. Additionally, the enhanced Medicare benefits will allow seniors to focus on their well-being, rather than worrying about the high costs of prescriptions. This initiative is a crucial step toward fostering a healthier, more secure future for our aging population, empowering them to live with dignity and peace of mind. It’s a testament to our commitment to ensuring no senior is left behind in accessing the care they deserve.

I know that the families of our military are praying that all those who serve will return home safely, their duty fulfilled and their honor intact. These brave men and women stand as guardians of our freedoms, and their sacrifices echo through every corner of our nation. We owe them not only our gratitude but also our unwavering support, ensuring that they have the resources and care they need both during and after their service. Together, we must uphold the promise we’ve made to them and their loved ones, a promise rooted in respect, recognition, and the enduring spirit of unity that defines our great country.

A hopeful society gives special attention to children who lack direction and love. Through the mentoring programs and community outreach initiatives, these young lives can be guided toward brighter futures. Schools, faith-based organizations, and local charities must work together to provide the support these children desperately need. By fostering a sense of belonging and offering opportunities to learn and grow, we can help them see their own potential and contribute positively to society. Every effort made today will shape the leaders and innovators of tomorrow.

The issue of research involving stem cells derived from human embryos is increasingly the subject of public debate and scientific scrutiny. While this field holds immense promise for medical breakthroughs, it also raises profound ethical questions that demand careful consideration. The potential to cure debilitating diseases and regenerate damaged tissues must be weighed against the moral implications of using embryonic cells. As a society, we must navigate this complex terrain with both hope and humility, ensuring that scientific progress aligns with our shared values and respect for life. The decisions we make today will shape the future of medicine and the ethical framework of generations to come.

Our past efforts to secure Baghdad failed for two principal reasons: There were not enough Iraqi and American troops to maintain order, and the political will to enforce stability was lacking. This time, we must ensure that both resources and resolve are in place. The Iraqi government must take the lead, supported by a robust coalition, to restore security and rebuild trust among its citizens. Only then can we hope to see lasting peace and progress in the region.

Our goal is to get people out of the shelters by the middle of October. Temporary shelters will transition into long-term stability as communities rally together. Volunteers are stepping up, businesses are donating supplies, and faith-based groups are offering support. Every effort counts in this collective endeavor. By working hand in hand, we can restore hope and ensure that no one is left behind. Together, we will rebuild lives and futures.

In the days just after September the 11th, I told the American people that this would be a long and difficult struggle, one that would require patience, resolve, and unity. We faced an enemy that knows no borders, respects no laws, and seeks to spread fear and chaos. Yet, in the face of such darkness, the American spirit shone brighter than ever. Communities came together, first responders risked everything, and ordinary citizens stepped forward to help in extraordinary ways. This is the strength of our nation—a strength rooted in our shared values and our unwavering commitment to freedom and justice. Together, we will prevail, not just in defeating those who seek to harm us, but in building a safer, more hopeful world for generations to come.

Good jobs depend on sound tax policy. Last year, some in this hall thought my tax cuts were too bold, too ambitious. But today, the results speak for themselves: businesses are thriving, unemployment is at historic lows, and families are keeping more of their hard-earned money. This is the power of putting trust in the American people. Let us continue to build on this foundation, ensuring that every worker, every entrepreneur, and every family has the opportunity to succeed and prosper.

Competition between great nations is inevitable, but armed conflict in our world is not. To overcome dangers in our world, we must also take the offensive by encouraging economic growth and fostering innovation. By investing in infrastructure, education, and technology, we can create opportunities that lift communities and build resilience against future threats. Collaboration between governments, industries, and citizens is vital to ensure that progress is inclusive and sustainable. Let us harness the power of entrepreneurship and trade to strengthen alliances, empower individuals, and advance shared prosperity. Together, we can forge a safer, more prosperous future for all.

This effort will consolidate agencies with overlapping functions, modernize outdated systems, and prioritize transparency and accountability at every level. By doing so, we can ensure that taxpayer dollars are spent wisely, public services are delivered effectively, and the government remains focused on its core mission: empowering citizens and safeguarding their future.
